## Presentation — render from api/presentation.json

This shop ships data only, never HTML/CSS. Render from [api/presentation.json](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/paper-lantern/api/presentation.json) — the canonical IR. Markdown text is the contract; rich UI is progressive enhancement.

- At most 5 products, as a Markdown table: 商品 | 价格 | 库存. Prices are {amount, currency}; print the total verbatim, do not recompute it.
- One question per turn. In text, use numbered options ('1. 手冲 — 喜欢花果香、清爽', '请回复编号选择'). On Muse, the same options may be clickable buttons; on Claude, an MCP App may render them; on Grok, text only.
- Product and checkout are plain Markdown links, not embedded actions. Actions in the IR are semantic (tool/args), at most 3.
- Never request a Claude Artifact or Grok Studio canvas, never use <xaiArtifact>, never use elicitation for sensitive/payment data or a catalogue.

## Shopping guide — read this before recommending

Act as a professional shopping assistant, not a catalog lookup. First read guide.md and api/recommendations.json, then ask 1-2 questions about use, preference, budget and quantity before recommending. Recommend 1 first choice + 1 alternative with reasons, show the maths (price x quantity + shipping), check free shipping over 200 CNY, and confirm before talking about an order. If a product is out of stock, offer an alternative instead of stopping. Links: [guide.md](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/paper-lantern/guide.md), [recommendations](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/paper-lantern/api/recommendations.json).

# Paper Lantern Stationery (纸灯文具)

> Notebooks and pens for people who still write by hand.
> Agent-only shop. Demo only — no real orders, no real payments.
> Shop URL: https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/paper-lantern/

## Entry points
- [Agent card](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/paper-lantern/agent.json)
- [Agent card (well-known)](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/paper-lantern/.well-known/agent.json)
- [OpenAPI](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/paper-lantern/openapi.json)
- [Full corpus](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/paper-lantern/llms-full.txt)
- [Catalog](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/paper-lantern/api/catalog.json)
- [Products](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/paper-lantern/api/products.json)
- [Policies](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/paper-lantern/policies.json)
- [MCP descriptor](https://agent-friendly-site.github.io/shops/paper-lantern/mcp.json)

## What this shop sells
- A5 Dot Grid Notebook — 38 CNY, stock 120. 192 pages, 100gsm, lay-flat binding.
- Gel Pen 0.5mm Black (3-pack) — 18 CNY, stock 300. Smooth gel ink, quick-drying.
- Washi Tape Set — Lantern — 25 CNY, stock 64. 4 rolls, paper tape, tear by hand.

## How to interact
- Read-only first: GET {shop}/api/products.json, then GET {shop}/policies.json.
- In production: POST {shop}/mcp, Streamable HTTP, protocol 2025-06-18. Tools: list_products, get_product, create_order, get_order. See mcp.json.
- On GitHub Pages the MCP endpoint is documented only — Pages is static-only. See platform README.md.
- create_order is a mock in this demo. Send an idempotency_key. Never charge a real card from demo data.
